# Axel Wyart

> Axel Wyart is a Design Director and AI product design leader based in Biarritz, France. He helps founders and product teams turn strategy into shipped AI products across product design, UX/UI, design systems, brand, and design operations.

## Expertise

- AI and LLM product design: copilots, agents, conversational interfaces, workflow builders, generative experiences, evaluation, trust, and user control
- Product strategy and UX/UI: discovery, user flows, prototyping, research, prioritization, and delivery
- Design leadership: team direction, executive alignment, hiring, mentoring, and product-design collaboration
- Design systems and operations: shared foundations, governance, workflows, and adoption

## Experience

- Design Director at Foundever, leading design for AI products used by thousands of agents
- Former Head of Product Design at Laiye, working on global AI and automation platforms
- Built the design function at Mindsay, supporting its growth and acquisition
- More than ten years of experience designing and scaling digital products

## Location and availability

Axel is based in Biarritz, France. He works with teams in Biarritz, the Pays Basque, France, Europe, and internationally. Engagements may include product audits, strategic workshops, design sprints, critical product flows, AI experience design, and design foundations, depending on availability.
